messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem notes 1 - thanks for the detailed writeup. I pulled out the action items into a compact triage list. Can owners confirm assignment + realistic ETA? Jira links after the list.

maria: Ill take the KV eviction safeguards task. Need two full sprints to validate across burst scenarios, ETA: 2024-05-24. :+1:

kevin: I can own the autoscaler rollback and regression plan. Target: PR by EOD Tue, rollout Wed.

alex: Current ticket set (provisional owners):
``
INF-889 (maria) - prefix/KV cache eviction safeguards
INF-890 (kevin) - autoscaler rollback + regression tests
SEC-312 (olivia) - KMS/key rotation audit + policy updates
OPS-201 (samir) - runbook updates + escalation tuning
PMT-421 (tanya) - external comms + postmortem publish
```

tanya: PMT-421 ack. Will draft comms tomorrow and loop in legal if needed. ETA Thu.

olivia: SEC-312 ack but need the last 30 days of KMS audit exports. @jen can you share S3 path or drop the export?

jen: olivia 	 uploaded to `s3://redwood-incident-exports/2024-05/secure-logs.gz`. Use `aws s3 cp` to pull. I also adjusted bucket policy for security-read role.

samir: OPS-201 	I'll update the runbook and proposed pager thresholds to reduce flapping. Will pair with oncall this week. Target Fri COB.

alex: RACI check: owners above = Responsible. Please state who is Accountable (manager-level preferred), and who should be Consulted / Informed. If no replies by EOD tomorrow Ill escalate.

kevin: Accountable INF-890: kevin. Consulted: eng-runtime (cc @maria). Informed: product/infra.

maria: Accountable INF-889: maria. Consulted: eng-sre, runtime. Informed: infra.

olivia: Accountable SEC-312: olivia. Consulted: security-ops. Informed: compliance/legal.

alex: I'll add sub-tasks for verification steps (smoke tests + perf acceptance) in each Jira ticket. Also adding a label to flag recurring incidents.

deploy-bot: [deployed] infra/caching-protections v1.3 to staging at 2024-05-03T15:12:09Z

tanya: Suggestion: schedule a recurring 15m sync next Wed for owners to quick-update status. Cuts down on thread noise.

alex: Scheduled: Wednesdays 10:00 PT, 15m triage. Calendar invite sent to all owners and accountable people.

kevin: Please add an explicit checkbox on each ticket: "Recurring-pattern review". We saw the eviction+autoscaler interaction twice in 90 days; want this prioritized in the QBR.

alex: Done 	 added label `recurring-pattern: cache-eviction+autoscaler` and checklist item to each ticket.

maria: Confirmed INF-889 owner + ETA in the ticket comments. Will post incremental updates in the triage meeting and ticket.

alex: Thanks team. If there are blockers (access, scope creep), call them out here and we'll escalate. I'll close the coordination loop when acceptance criteria and dates are in all tickets. :thumbsup:
